sections.title: Introduction
content: This Privacy Policy explains how Axio Studio collects, uses, stores, and protects information when you use Reelz on Android or the web.
By using Reelz, you acknowledge the practices described in this Policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
content: When you sign in with Google, we may receive your name, email address, profile picture, and Google account identifier.
We collect usage information such as watch history, search history, favorites, downloads, continue watching, recently played items, clicks, and time spent using Reelz.
We do not intentionally collect unnecessary device information beyond what is required to operate the service.

sections.title: Permissions
content: Depending on the features you use, Reelz may request access to camera, location, nearby devices, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, and storage to provide offline transfer, downloads, and related features.

sections.title: How We Use Information
content: We use information to provide, secure, improve, personalize, and support Reelz and Premium features.

sections.title: Analytics
content: Reelz uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics to improve reliability and performance.

sections.title: Advertising
content: Free users may receive ads from third-party advertising partners. Those partners may process information under their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Payments
content: Premium payments are processed by third-party providers. Reelz receives only the information needed to verify transactions.

sections.title: Sharing
content: We do not sell personal information. Limited information may be shared with trusted providers needed to operate Reelz.

sections.title: Security
content: We use HTTPS, authenticated services, and reasonable safeguards to protect your information.

sections.title: Your Rights
content: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your information by contacting support.

sections.title: Retention
content: Following a verified deletion request, account information is removed, while limited logs may be retained where necessary.
